solution: Let a=ln2 and b=ln3. Then x=(a+2b)/(2a+b), y=(a+3b)/(3a+b). Over the common denominator (2a+b)(3a+b), the numerator of xy+5(x−y) is (a+2b)(a+3b)+5(a²−b²)=6a²+5ab+b², exactly that denominator.
